goal: Pass an explicit --pause-ms 1000 on the daily ColdLion Landing Sync's prepack-detail refresh step so the 2,577-code re-read fits the job's 90-minute budget instead of overrunning it at the loader's 3,000ms default.
dispatcher: delegated source-data session continuing issue #3179 production phase
prohibited_actions: Never author a migration or change any database shape; this is a workflow pacing change only.
Never weaken a workflow guard: the offline tests still run before any write, the declared target stays beside every credential, and the missing-secret refusals stay.
Never remove or reorder the history-then-masters-then-prepack sequence.
Never close issue #3179; the originating session owns closure.
assumptions: The live dry-run dispatched after PR #3220 merged measured 2,577 distinct harvested prepack codes and ~3.1s per code at the 3,000ms default pace.
The vendor agreement is serialized one-request-at-a-time; a 1,000ms pause keeps it while landing the full refresh in ~45 minutes beside history+masters' ~8 minutes, inside the 90-minute job budget.
The backfill workflow already accepts pause_ms per dispatch, so only the scheduled step needs the baked-in pace.
stop_conditions: Stop and report a blocker if the measured daily refresh plus history and masters would exceed the job timeout at any acceptable pace.
Stop on any unresolved guard or reviewer refusal; a new head answering it requires a fresh exact-head review.
